profile_text.body:
Stack AI is a software company that describes itself as a platform for deploying AI agents at scale within enterprise environments. Its core offering is a no-code, drag-and-drop builder that allows organizations to construct and launch AI applications and automated workflows without writing code. The platform advertises more than 100 enterprise integrations, enabling agents to read, write, and execute tasks inside existing business systems, and the company positions its product around security, compliance, and governance in regulated industries.

The company's tracked product, also called Stack AI, falls in the coding and developer tools category and is described as a no-code AI app builder with capabilities spanning enterprise deployment, workflow automation, and data connector governance. Customer quotations on the site reference use cases in corporate departmental functions, student-facing educational tools, and banking environments where governance and regulatory oversight are cited as relevant factors.

No litigation, patent filings, MCP server registrations, or SEC disclosures appear in the held facts for Stack AI.
